purpose: Prevent meter telemetry volume from being mistaken for jackpot-event sample size and register deep external histories only as non-transferable hypothesis sources.

sampleUnits.meterObservation: One timestamped meter reading. This is useful for growth curves and detecting transitions, but it is not a jackpot award.
sampleUnits.candidateCycle: A reset-like transition inferred from direct meter telemetry. It may be an award, reset, administrative action, configuration change or other transition until verified.
sampleUnits.fullObservedCycle: A complete interval observed between two reset-like candidate boundaries. This is the descriptive timing sample n.
sampleUnits.verifiedAward: A reset/cycle boundary independently verified as an actual jackpot award. This is the strongest event sample n.
sampleUnits.externalReferenceWin: A dated win reported by an external tracker. It remains outside the Spain operational sample unless exact configuration identity is proven.
